# Food safety (test fixture)

Test fixture for Aman's retrieval tests. The real knowledge base is written by Anhad in data/kb/.
Values summarise the FSSAI "Food Industry Guide to implement GMP/GHP requirements: Catering" (Oct 2017).

## Hot holding

High-risk cooked food must be held at 65 C or above, or at 5 C or below.
Hot food held below 65 C must be eaten within 2 hours. Otherwise it must be reheated to 75 C for 2 minutes, and it must not be reheated again after that.

## Reheating gravies and meat

Gravies, meat, poultry and fish may be reheated only once. Leftovers remaining after reheating must be discarded.

## Cooling and storage

Cooked food must be cooled from 60 C to 21 C within 2 hours, and then to 5 C within 4 more hours.
Cooked food should be eaten within 24 hours of preparation.
